Name: More-ay Eels
Author: StarandVeil
Description:
[center][left][b][size=4][u]Description[/u][/size][/b][/left]
[/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]More-ay Eels adds 19 new eels to Stardew Valley, including two legendary eels. The eels can be caught in the Calico Desert, Pirate Cove, The Mines, and other locations. Each eel can be put in fish ponds where they may offer different and some rare items to your farmer.[/size] [/color]
